summary: Checked that Twilio is live and ready to dial. No real calls were placed. Backend: new safe suite test_twilio_live.py, 11/11 pass. Results: /twilio/status (admin) returns has_credentials=true, connected=true and caller_id=+18506050135. /twilio/caller-ids (agent) lists +18506050135 and +14079065477, with +18506050135 as the default. /twilio/token returns a valid 3-part JWT for both admin and agent; grants.identity matches the user id and the outgoing application_sid starts with AP. Without a token, the status and token endpoints return 401. /twilio/voice and /twilio/dial-status return 403 when the signature is missing or bogus. POST /dialer/next with caller_id +19999999999 returns 400 'That caller ID isn't on your Twilio account', and nothing was claimed: on a TEST_ list there were 0 in_progress contacts, 0 attempts and 0 new calls. Unknown list + bogus caller also returns 400. /twilio/numbers returns 403 for agents and 200 with the live number for admins (the iteration_1 500 is fixed). Frontend as admin at 1920px and 390px: no twilio-not-ready-banner. dialer-caller-id-select shows +18506050135 selected, with both numbers as options. The real list is auto-selected and dialer-start-btn is ENABLED (not clicked). Settings shows the 'Ready to dial' pill, 'Browser calling connected', the webhook https://call-queue-3--9sfzaxf3.preview.emergentagent.com/api/twilio/voice, and twilio-settings-caller-select = +18506050135. No error toasts and no horizontal overflow at 390px. The UI made no POST requests.

issues: The Hang up button is still shown in bright red while idle with no active call (carried over from iteration_1).

critical_code_review_comments: dialer_next validates a non-default caller_id before get_list_or_404. This is safe because nothing is claimed, but an unknown list with a bogus caller returns 400 rather than 404.

Dialer.jsx: if /twilio/caller-ids fails or returns no numbers, callerId falls back to the localStorage value or data.default. 'ready' can then be true while the select shows 'No caller ID'. The backend still guards this (it only checks against the default), but this is a UI inconsistency.
A caller_id equal to the stored default skips the live Twilio check. That is fine as long as the default is only set through the validated PATCH.
server.py is now 785 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Split it into routers (twilio, dialer, lists, files, ai).
